dct_description_sm: The intention with the collection of this data is to review existing food security assessment tools for Inuit communities, adapt and validate a tool for use in Inuit communities in the future, pilot test the application of this tool and review northern food and food related policies in the North.  This project is being done in support of decision making bodies (communities, regional governments and food support organizations) related to northern food security.

dct_title_s: Food security tools and policy review in Canadian Arctic
